scope: Only foreground-gallery-roof.js and this namespace. The entire fitted roof transform, surface formula, edge families, lane/course layout, cap anchors/bases, tile walls/laps and support datums are retained. Shell sampling is denser for rounded highlights. Main hall, camera, sky, lights, pines and garden are unchanged by this lane.
reference: references/hd/6-照片-7.jpg, visual comparison only; never read by surface generator.

independentSource.author: Rob Tuytel
independentSource.primaryPageVerified: Asset page identifies Rob Tuytel and CC0; publisher license explicitly covers textures and redistribution.

derivation.method: Joint-free flat ceramic interiors selected from independent scan; overlap-add matching diffuse/normal/roughness samples, remove broad source molding normals; add declared authored low-frequency kiln/glaze variation. No source tile seams, roof image plate, target RGB, camera mapping or depth projection.
derivation.physicalCaveat: Target glaze coverage, pigment, IOR and sample frequency are source-led modeling hypotheses, not a measured target BRDF.
derivation.metalMaps: Project-authored deterministic casting pores and roughness. No external bronze image.

geometry.method: A closed relief disk with six connected rounded scroll/petal sectors, central cast boss and24small beads; relief merges into its bronze ground. A separate closed recessed bronze seat, rolled bronze retaining rim and narrow rounded gilt bead fit the retained thick ceramic seal. Three small wear variants share the same old cap anchor/basis.

material.uv: Across true rounded cross arc, along actual tile curve; deterministic per-tile metric offsets; OpenGL normal convention.
material.casts: Rounded crests retain spatially broken gilt with darker bronze ground and cast pore/roughness fields.

checks.claims: Closed topology and positive volume are CPU geometry checks only. Shader loading and image appearance must be checked by the official native capture.
